description: Public threat feeds downloaded by `update-feeds`. Review each licence before enabling. Which feeds run is controlled by UNMASK_ENABLED_FEEDS. Formats: urls | hosts | cidr_json_lines | cidr_text | asn_json_lines | asn_text.

feeds.name: openphish
feeds.title: OpenPhish Community Feed
feeds.terms: Free for NON-COMMERCIAL use only; refreshed about every 12 hours. Commercial deployments need a licence from OpenPhish.

feeds.name: spamhaus_drop
feeds.title: Spamhaus DROP (IPv4 netblocks)
feeds.terms: Free of charge; credit to The Spamhaus Project must accompany use. Changes daily, so refresh at least daily.

feeds.name: spamhaus_drop_v6
feeds.title: Spamhaus DROP (IPv6 netblocks)
feeds.terms: Free of charge; credit to The Spamhaus Project must accompany use.

feeds.name: spamhaus_asndrop
feeds.title: Spamhaus ASN-DROP (hijacked / criminal networks)
feeds.terms: Free of charge; credit to The Spamhaus Project must accompany use.
